image_description: A full-body shot of a large, greyish-green common iguana standing on a grassy surface in an enclosure. The iguana is positioned diagonally, facing right, with its head raised. It features a prominent dorsal crest running down its spine and a long tail extending behind it. The background consists of rocky walls and some foliage.
